name: CraneMath
intro: CraneMath 是 Olmo 3 第二阶段中期训练语料，而不是独立评测集。它以 FineMath4+ 为源，复用 SwallowMath 提示并由 Qwen3-32B 重写，得到 5.62B tokens 的许可更宽松数学语料；其 MATH/GSM8K 数值来自数据质量 microanneal 消融。
build_method: 以 FineMath4+ 为源，使用 SwallowMath 公开提示和 Qwen3-32B 独立重写，生成许可更宽松的合成数学中期训练语料
metric: 数据消融：MATH/GSM8K 分数变化（非 CraneMath Accuracy）
eval_feature: 以 6T-token 基础模型做 50% 网页、50% 候选源 microanneal，对比 MATH、GSM8K 与 MMLU 变化
scale: 源数据池 5.62B tokens、6.55M 文档；Olmo 3 100B 混合中占 5.63%
build_method_en: Rewrite FineMath4+ independently with the published SwallowMath prompt and Qwen3-32B to create a more permissively licensed synthetic math midtraining corpus
eval_feature_en: Run 50% web/50% candidate-source microanneals from a 6T-token base model and compare MATH, GSM8K and MMLU changes
intro_en: CraneMath is Olmo 3 Stage-2 midtraining data, not a standalone evaluation set. It rewrites FineMath4+ with the published SwallowMath prompt using Qwen3-32B, yielding a 5.62B-token permissively generated math corpus; its MATH/GSM8K numbers are data-quality microanneal ablations.
scale_en: Source pool: 5.62B tokens and 6.55M documents; 5.63% of the Olmo 3 100B mix
metric_en: Data ablation: MATH/GSM8K score changes (not CraneMath Accuracy)
flowchart_en: FineMath4+ → SwallowMath rewrite recipe → Qwen3-32B rewrite → 5.62B-token CraneMath pool → corpus identity boundary → Olmo 3 mix and microanneal utility validation.
flowchart_zh: FineMath4+ → SwallowMath 重写配方 → Qwen3-32B 重写 → 5.62B-token CraneMath 数据池 → 语料身份边界 → Olmo 3 混合与 microanneal 效用验证。
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Olmo 3 arXiv:2512.13961 Sections 3.5 and Appendix A.3.1 plus the official Dolma 3 Dolmino pool and mix cards. CraneMath is a Qwen3-32B rewrite of FineMath4+ using the SwallowMath prompt, released as a 5.62B-token synthetic math midtraining source. The diagram distinguishes the 6.55M-document source pool from its 5.63% inclusion in the 100B-token mix and treats MATH/GSM8K/MMLU microanneals as data ablation, not a standalone CraneMath benchmark score.
